title: An artifact-only run keeps the diff files COMPLETE writes
description: Start an isolated gateway with its own pool, projects, runs, home and tmux server (no node: the slot is local). A scripted worker commits one change in an artifact-only dev run. MONITOR captures the worker's output, then COMPLETE writes artifacts/diff.txt and its siblings and captures again. Every diff file the run lists must return 200 from /api/run-artifact, served from the bundle run.get names, and the output identity must stay the one MONITOR captured while the bundle changes. Negative control: with the retained capture key that leaves the diff files out, the reads return 404 and the bundle digest stays the worker capture's.

late-diff-retention.intent: The diff files written at COMPLETE are served from the run's retained bundle without changing its output identity.
